# SpikingNeuralAccelerator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A specialized FPGA-based hardware architecture designed to accelerate the inference and local learning of spiking neural networks with high energy efficiency. Provides a practical implementation path for deploying adaptive SNNs in edge and in-network environments where power and latency constraints dominate.
